comment: Same-position attribute renames between bundled IFC releases (F3e-0b, #7780).
The slot generator (src/rust-slot-emitter.ts) names a slot by its canonical IFC4X3 name and treats a listed older spelling as the SAME attribute.
Every row is validated: a row whose names sit at different positions in two schemas fails generation, so a rename can never cover a move.
A row applies to the listed entities and all of their subtypes.

Semantic replacements are NOT renames and stay out of this file: CompositionType -> PredefinedType (IfcBuildingElementProxy), InteriorOrExteriorSpace -> PredefinedType (IfcSpace), ShapeType -> PredefinedType (IfcRamp, IfcRoof, IfcStair), BarRole -> PredefinedType (IfcReinforcingBar) and OperationType -> PredefinedType (IfcTransportElement) each name a different enumeration. They stay moving slots and read as absent in IFC2X3.
UrlReference -> URLReference (IfcImageTexture) is also not a rename: IFC4 inserted attributes before it, so it moved (4 -> 5).
Such a moved attribute whose old spelling would give the same slot name as the new one is listed under "omit": it gets no slot, and the texture readers pin IFC4 (D6).
